item.title: Special Issue Proposals
item.content:encoded:
The Human Resource Management Journal invites proposals for special issues that address contemporary topics within human resource management. Proposals should demonstrate significant theoretical advancement, employ rigorous and innovative methodologies, and engage critically with real-world policy and practice issues relevant to the field.

Appel publié par Human Resource Management Journal. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Themes related to the core aims and scope of the Journal
  • Cutting edge theoretical contributions
  • Methodological innovation and rigour
  • Critical scholarship engaging with policy and/or practice

Timeline

  • August 25, 2026: Submission deadline for special issue proposals
